newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at firmer Nov Brent +11 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at firmer Nov Brent +11 cents.

text.p: The first wet barrels of November Brent traded on Friday at a wider premium to paper amid thin supply of early month cargoes, traders said.
A Brent cargo nominated loading dates of November 4-6 and kept by the equity holder early on Friday was sold for Nov Brent +11 cents to a trade house, they added.
The last Brent trade was on Wednesday at Dec IPE +65 cents, equivalent to about Nov Brent +4 cents.
